terminal.title: Interactive terminal
terminal.intro: Start an explicitly authorized shell in its own attempt worktree. Terminal output and process exit do not approve a task or prove tests passed.
terminal.select_task: Choose a task above before creating or viewing its terminal sessions.
terminal.recent_sessions: Showing up to 20 recent sessions for this task, plus the current session if it is outside that page. This is not the complete history.
terminal.profiles_partial: The terminal profile catalog is bounded and incomplete. An empty page does not prove no other profile exists.
terminal.no_sessions: No terminal session has been created for this task.
terminal.no_profile: No currently authorized terminal profile is available. Configure a PTY-capable Runner before continuing.
terminal.consent: I authorize an interactive shell in this task's separate attempt worktree. It can run programs and change files; the editor's shared directory is not used.
terminal.detach_hint: Closing or disconnecting this view does not confirm the shell stopped. Reconnecting resumes the same session; it does not start another shell.
terminal.stop_pending: Stop requested. Wait for the Runner's actual process-tree stop result.
terminal.too_much_output: Too much output to announce. Navigate the terminal rows to read the remaining content.
terminal.input_unknown: Delivery of the previous input is unknown. It will not be resent automatically. Inspect this session before deciding whether to enter new input.
terminal.input_rejected: Some input was not sent or was rejected. It has not been replayed. Check the terminal before entering more text; a single input must not exceed 8 KiB.
terminal.input_accepted: Input accepted for delivery. This does not mean the shell executed it.
terminal.input_delivered: Previous input bytes were delivered to the PTY. Command completion remains separate.
terminal.output_gap: Some earlier output is no longer retained. The visible history is incomplete.
terminal.read_only: Viewing only. Input and shell control require current creator permission.
terminal.access_changed: Access changed. Protected terminal output is hidden and no new input is sent.
terminal.pending: The original session or control request is awaiting confirmation. Recover that request; do not create another shell.
terminal.invalid_read: The terminal response could not be verified. Check the original session.
terminal.load_failed: The terminal renderer could not load. Refresh the application before reconnecting.
terminal.connection.retrying: Connection interrupted; reconnecting to the same session
